convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (i-CAiChannel_System_Digit) with external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and money management. Custom indicator buffers (8,9) require custom implementation in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans control signal-based closes on opposite signal; BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle actual close logic

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum (LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=MM% of free margin, BALANCE=MM% of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=MM% of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=MM% of balance minus loss). MM input (0.1) acts as lot size when MMMode=LOT, or as percentage fraction for other modes.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads 2 values from custom indicator buffer 8 at offset SignalBar and SignalBar+1. Long entry: Col[1]>2 (digit channel above threshold) AND Col[0]<3. Short entry: Col[1]<2 (digit channel below threshold) AND Col[0]>1. Signal time is computed as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as master switches for each direction. Recount flag retriggers signal calculation on failure. SignalBar=0 disables new bar guard allowing intrabar signals.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator i-CAiChannel_System_Digit must be reimplemented in Python. It uses SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which provides JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing methods beyond standard SMA/EMA. The indicator has 9+ buffers; the EA reads buffer index 8 for a digit-based channel system. Entry conditions compare buffer values to integer thresholds (1,2,3) suggesting a discrete/channel-based signal system. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose/GlobalVariableDel_ which encapsulate order sending, position checking, and margin calculation - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode LOT vs percentage-based sizing needs careful handling. Signal time (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to open functions likely for order expiration or trailing logic within TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
